agent.hint.env: Michel could not prepare the environment of Claude Code. Restart Michel, then try again.
agent.hint.not_installed: Claude Code is not installed on this computer. Install it (https://claude.com/claude-code), then try again. Meanwhile, you can read the brief.
agent.hint.not_logged_in: Claude Code is not logged in. Run claude in a terminal and log in, then try again. Meanwhile, you can read the brief.
agent.hint.slow: Claude Code did not answer in time: Michel does not know yet whether he can use it. Try again in a moment.
agent.hint.too_old: Your version of Claude Code is too old: Michel cannot run it apart from your own settings. Update it with claude update, then try again.
api.bad_host: Refused: this address is not the one Michel listens on.
api.bad_json_hint: Send one JSON object with only the fields action, why and until.
api.bad_last: Michel cannot read the number of digests to show.
api.bad_last_hint: Use last= with a whole number from 1 to %d.
api.bad_origin: Refused: the request comes from another site.
api.closing: Michel is stopping: the analysis was not started. Start Michel again, then try again.
api.decision.audit_failed: The decision was saved, but Michel could not write it to the audit log.
api.decision.bad_until: Michel cannot read the date. Write it as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-01.
api.decision.date_not_defer: A date only applies to a deferral.
api.decision.due_in_past: The deferral date is not in the future. Pick a later date.
api.decision.gone: This finding is no longer seen at the last scan.
api.decision.gone_hint: If it comes back, Michel will ask you again only if something changed.
api.decision.why_required: Ignoring a finding needs a reason: say why it does not matter to you. Michel keeps it in the audit log.
api.decision.why_too_long: The reason is too long: %d characters at most.
api.discover.add_kind: To add it, choose skill or mcp.
api.exposure.firewall.reason: Michel reads this list from inside the server. It does not see the firewall of the host (the filter that decides who may connect), so it cannot say whether a service can be reached from outside.
api.exposure.udp.reason: Michel lists only the services that wait in TCP, the most common way to connect. A service that waits in UDP, the other way, does not appear.
api.fix.apply_failed: The fix is approved, but Michel could not create the branch in your repository.
api.fix.apply_failed_hint: Michel will try again the next time it starts. If it keeps failing, check that your repository is still in its folder.
api.fix.approve_hint: Reload the page to show the proposal, then approve it.
api.fix.continue_hint: Reload the page to show the list of keys, then answer.
api.fix.continue_need_hash: To go on, Michel must know which list of keys you read: reload the page, then try again.
api.fix.empty_message: The message is empty: write something for the agent.
api.fix.message_hint: Reload the page and try again. If it happens again, restart Michel.
api.fix.need_hash: To approve, Michel must know which proposal you read: reload the page, then try again.
api.fix.run_tests_hint: Reload the page to show the proposal, then run its tests.
api.fix.run_tests_need_hash: To run the tests, Michel needs to know which proposal you read: reload the page, then try again.
api.fix.unavailable: Fixing is not available here: start Michel with michel serve.
api.git.auth: The service refused access, or Michel found no Git access on this computer. Nothing changed.
api.git.auth_hint: Michel uses the access already set up and cannot ask you for it. Send once with your usual Git tool to save it, then try again.
api.git.bad_answer: This answer is not one Michel expects.
api.git.bad_answer_hint: Reload the page, then answer the question again.
api.git.branch_moved: This fix's branch changed or no longer exists: Michel sent nothing.
api.git.branch_moved_hint: It only sends what you approved. Start a new fix, or send the branch yourself.
api.git.busy: Michel is already working on this folder.
api.git.busy_hint: Wait for it to end, then try again.
api.git.default_unknown: Michel does not know your folder's main branch: it leaves it alone.
api.git.default_unknown_hint: Update with your usual Git tool.
api.git.detached: Your folder is on no branch: Michel leaves it alone.
api.git.detached_hint: Put it back on its main branch, then try again.
api.git.dirty: Your folder holds changes not saved yet: Michel leaves it alone.
api.git.dirty_hint: To see which, type git status in a terminal (the window where commands are typed), in your project's folder. Save them or set them aside, then try again.
api.git.diverged: Your folder holds saved work that is not on the site: Michel mixes nothing and left your files alone.
api.git.diverged_hint: Send it or settle this with your usual Git tool, then try again.
api.git.empty_repo: This Git repository holds nothing saved yet.
api.git.empty_repo_hint: Michel can check it and explain its flaws. It needs a first saved version to prepare a fix or send one.
api.git.failed: It failed for a reason Michel does not recognise. It does not show the detail, which may hold private data.
api.git.failed_hint: Try with your usual Git tool.
api.git.filter: This update would run a file conversion program (Git LFS for example): Michel does not run it and left your files alone.
api.git.filter_hint: Update with your usual Git tool, then click "Check this project".
api.git.host_key: This computer does not recognise this service, or its identity changed. Nothing changed.
api.git.host_key_hint: Connect once with your usual Git tool. If you already used to connect, ask for help: this change can be an attack.
api.git.ignored: A file or folder that Git ignores (often settings) stands where this update writes: Michel left your files alone.
api.git.ignored_hint: Move it elsewhere, then try again. Careful: an update made by hand with Git can overwrite it without warning.
api.git.in_progress: A merge or a pick is in progress in your folder: Michel leaves it alone.
api.git.in_progress_hint: Finish or cancel it, then try again.
api.git.network: Michel could not reach the service. Nothing changed.
api.git.network_hint: Check your Internet connection, then try again. A company proxy can also prevent it.
api.git.no_remote: Michel finds no usable address in this project.
api.git.no_remote_hint: It needs one https or SSH (secure connection) address, or one named origin.
api.git.no_repo: This folder is not a Git repository.
api.git.no_repo_hint: Michel can check it and explain its flaws, but cannot prepare a fix or send one.
api.git.no_rule: The network rule that allows this service was removed: Michel did nothing.
api.git.no_rule_hint: Answer the question again on the project's page.
api.git.not_applied: This fix has no branch to send.
api.git.not_applied_hint: A branch exists only after your approval, and until the fix is finished.
api.git.not_attached: This project is not attached to a Git service.
api.git.not_attached_hint: Answer yes on the project's page if you want to send your fixes there.
api.git.not_default: Your folder is on branch %s, not on the main branch %s: Michel leaves it alone.
api.git.not_default_hint: Go back to the main branch, then try again.
api.git.not_found: The service does not find this project, or your account has no access. Nothing changed.
api.git.not_found_hint: Check the address shown and that your account has access.
api.git.partial_clone: This folder is a partial copy of a repository: Git would fetch what it lacks on its own. So Michel neither sends nor updates here.
api.git.partial_clone_hint: Use your usual Git tool. For Michel to do it, it needs a full copy of the repository.
api.git.rejected: The service refused this branch. Michel never forces a send.
api.git.rejected_hint: A branch of the same name may exist with other content, or a rule of the service forbids it. Look on the site.
api.git.sent_not_noted: The fix did go: the branch is on the service, but Michel could not note it on his side.
api.git.sent_not_noted_hint: The fix was not sent twice. For Michel to note it, click again before merging: if the branch is still there, unchanged, he sends nothing more. If you already merged it and the site deleted it, do not click: Michel would send it again. If he still cannot note it, he will tell you.
api.git.remote_changed: The project's address changed since you agreed: Michel did nothing.
api.git.remote_changed_hint: Look at the project's page and answer again.
api.git.submodule: This update would remove or replace a subfolder Git manages apart (a submodule), and it is not empty: Michel left your files alone.
api.git.submodule_hint: Move its content elsewhere, empty this subfolder without deleting it, then try again. Careful: an update made by hand with Git can erase what it holds.
api.git.timeout: The service did not answer in time. Michel does not know whether it went through.
api.git.timeout_hint: Click again: if everything is already there, Michel sees it and sends nothing more.
api.git.untracked: A file in your folder would be overwritten by this update: Michel left your files alone.
api.git.untracked_hint: Move that file elsewhere, then try again.
api.git.update_failed: The update failed: Git stopped it.
api.git.update_failed_hint: Check your folder's state with your usual Git tool.
api.git.update_partial: The update stopped halfway: some files may have changed, others not. Michel put nothing back.
api.git.update_partial_hint: Close any program that may hold a file open (an editor, an antivirus). Your folder held no change before the update: with your usual Git tool, cancel these changes, then try again.
api.internal_hint: Try again. If it keeps failing, stop michel serve and start it again.
api.logs.bad_format: Michel does not know this log format.
api.logs.bad_format_hint: Pick php, postgres, monolog, json or text.
api.logs.bad_interval: This reading interval is not valid.
api.logs.bad_interval_hint: Write it like 5m or 2h, from 1m to 24h, or write manual to read only when you ask.
api.logs.bad_path: Michel cannot read this path as a log.
api.logs.bad_path_hint: Give the full path of a file on the server, starting with /. No "..", and a wildcard (* or ?) only in the file name.
api.logs.bad_scope: Choose what to erase: all or text.
api.logs.bad_settings: These log settings do not fit together.
api.logs.bad_settings_hint: The interval goes from 1 minute to 24 hours (or manual). The days kept go from 7 to 365, and never fewer than the days before an error counts as resolved. The text of alerts needs the text to be kept. The read size goes up to 64 MiB and the read time up to 300 seconds. An hour counts as a spike of errors if it has at least X times more than the hour before (X from 2 to 1000) and at least N in all (N from 1 to 1000000). The rules are immediate, digest or ignored.
api.logs.bad_source: This log source is incomplete or not valid.
api.logs.bad_source_hint: A JSON log needs the name of the field that holds the level. A field name holds only letters, digits and the signs _ . - (no space). A word list also accepts the space and a few plain signs such as | ( ) * + ?.
api.logs.bad_status: An error can only be marked seen or ignored.
api.logs.bad_status_hint: Send status as seen or ignored.
api.logs.busy: Michel is reading the logs of this server right now.
api.logs.busy_hint: Wait for the read to end, then try again.
api.logs.confirm_needed: This setting moves away from what Michel recommends, so it needs your confirmation.
api.logs.confirm_needed_hint: Read the risks, then send the same request again with confirmed set to true.
api.logs.duplicate_source: This log is already a source of this server.
api.logs.duplicate_source_hint: Change the existing source instead of adding it twice.
api.logs.error_not_found: No error of this server has this id.
api.logs.failure.denied: The server did not let Michel open this log. Ask whoever looks after your server to check the rights of the account Michel uses.
api.logs.failure.error: Michel does not know why the read failed. Check that the server is on, then click "Check now" higher up on this page: if Michel cannot connect to it, it will tell you.
api.logs.failure.error_source: Michel reached the server but could not read this log, and does not know why. It will try again. If this lasts, ask whoever looks after your server to check this file.
api.logs.failure.host_key_changed: This server no longer presents itself as before (its identity changed). Check with your host or your administrator before you trust it again.
api.logs.failure.host_key_unknown: Michel does not know this server yet. Confirm its fingerprint higher up on this page.
api.logs.failure.no_agent: The program that keeps your SSH key (ssh-agent) is locked or not running. Start it again on the computer that runs Michel.
api.logs.failure.no_key_accepted: The server did not accept your SSH key (your way in). Check that it is allowed on this server.
api.logs.failure.output_cut: The answer of the server was cut before the end. Michel could not read it all.
api.logs.failure.policy: Michel's own network rules do not let it reach this server. Check the network rules in Michel.
api.logs.failure.refused: The server refused the connection. The service that lets Michel in may be stopped, or the address Michel has for this server may no longer be right.
api.logs.failure.timeout: The server took too long to answer. It may be overloaded or unreachable.
api.logs.failure.tools: A program Michel needs to read the logs (awk, tail, head) is missing on the server.
api.logs.interval.manual: Michel reads the logs of this server only when you ask for it on the command line. Nobody is warned in between.
api.logs.interval.slow: With this interval, an error can wait more than 10 minutes before you hear of it.
api.logs.no_channel: Michel will read this log, but nothing is set up to warn you (email, webhook or desktop notification): nobody will be told. Set up a channel; until then a badge stays on this server.
api.logs.note.gap: Michel could not read this log from %[1]s to %[2]s.
api.logs.note.rejected: Michel threw away some lines of the server's answer that did not have the expected form.
api.logs.note.rotated: The log was replaced or emptied: what was left in the old file was not read.
api.logs.note.skipped: Part of this log was not read (%s): it grew faster than Michel can read in one pass.
api.logs.note.too_many_files: This source matches more files than Michel reads in one pass: some were left out.
api.logs.note.unseen.one: %d file of this source could not be read.
api.logs.note.unseen.other: %d files of this source could not be read.
api.logs.postgres_prefix: To see the code of a PostgreSQL error, put %e in log_line_prefix, and put it last, just before the message (for example '%m [%p] %e '). Without it, Michel sees only the severity.
api.logs.risk.alert_text: The cleaned message will also go in alerts, so it leaves this computer: to your mail provider, to the recipient of your webhook, to your notifications. The same limit applies: a name written without quotes can stay in it.
api.logs.risk.health: This server is marked as holding health data. Text taken from its logs could leave your health data hosting (HDS): it would stay on this computer and reach the recipients of your alerts. Michel does not forbid it, but you stay responsible for it. Ask your data protection officer (DPO) if you are not sure.
api.logs.risk.retention: Michel keeps the error data for a time other than the 90 days it recommends. The longer the data stays, the longer it can be exposed; the shorter, the less history you keep.
api.logs.risk.store_text: Michel will keep a cleaned copy of the error messages on this computer: quoted strings, numbers, IP addresses, emails and web addresses are replaced, and the text is cut at 200 characters. A name written without quotes can still stay in it. Michel never keeps a raw log line. If you go back to keeping no text, Michel erases what it stored at once.
api.logs.source_not_found: No log source of this server has this id.
api.logs.try.empty: Nothing came back from this log. It may be empty, nothing may have gone wrong in it yet, or the format may not fit. Try another format.
api.logs.try.unreadable: Michel could not make sense of this log with this format. Try another format.
api.logs.try_failed: Michel could not read this log on the server.
api.logs.try_failed_hint: Check the path, the rights of the account Michel signs in with, and that awk is installed on the server.
api.logs.unseen.absent: This file does not exist, or Michel cannot see it. Check the path. If the file appears later, Michel will read it from its start.
api.logs.unseen.denied: Ask whoever looks after your server to give Michel the right to read this file. Michel cannot open this file with the account it signs in with, and it never uses sudo. Often the fix is to add that account to the group that reads logs (adm on Debian and Ubuntu).
api.logs.unseen.denied_folder: Ask whoever looks after your server to give Michel the right to read this folder. Michel cannot open this folder with the account it signs in with, and it never uses sudo. Often the fix is to add that account to the group that reads logs (adm on Debian and Ubuntu).
api.logs.unseen.link: This path is a symbolic link (a shortcut). Michel does not follow links: declare the real path of the file instead.
api.logs.unseen.not_file: This is not an ordinary file (it may be a folder). Michel reads only ordinary files.
api.logs.unseen.other: Michel could not read this file correctly this time: it changed while being read, or its name has characters Michel does not accept. It will try again at the next read.
api.logs.unseen.tools: The server lacks a tool that Michel needs to read the logs (awk, tail, head, tr, ls or wc), or one of them failed. Michel installs nothing on a server.
api.logs.why.php_error_log_cli: The PHP command line writes its errors here (error_log).
api.logs.why.php_error_log_pool: A PHP-FPM pool writes its errors here.
api.logs.why.postgresql_default_folder: The usual place of the PostgreSQL logs on Debian and Ubuntu.
api.logs.why.project_storage_logs: The storage/logs folder of a project that lives on this server.
api.logs.why.project_var_log: The var/log folder of a project that lives on this server.
api.need_json: The request body must be JSON (Content-Type: application/json).
api.no_ui: Michel's interface is not built into this copy of the program. Run 'make web', then start michel serve again. The API under /api/v1 works without it.
api.not_found: This API address does not exist.
api.plugin_run_not_found: No plugin run has this id.
api.project.add.bad_json_hint: Send one JSON object with only the fields path and name.
api.project.bad_name: This project name will not do.
api.project.bad_name_hint: Pick a name of 64 characters at most: letters and digits, with spaces, dots or dashes inside if you wish.
api.project.duplicate: Michel already follows this folder, or a project already has this name.
api.project.duplicate_hint: Pick another name, or check the project already in My projects. A removed project keeps its name as long as its history exists.
api.project.forbidden_path: Michel refuses this folder: it is not the folder of a project.
api.project.forbidden_path_hint: Michel accepts neither a system folder, a whole disk, your whole home folder, a network folder, a folder reached through a link or a junction (a folder that leads to another one), a hidden folder of your home folder nor its own data. Give the folder of the project itself.
api.project.no_database: Michel does not have the list of known flaws yet: without it, it cannot check this project.
api.project.no_database_hint: Download the list of flaws first: open the Sources page and click "Update now". Then click "Check this project" again.
api.project.not_dir: Michel cannot find this folder on this computer.
api.project.not_dir_hint: Check the path: it must lead to a folder that exists, not to a file.
api.project.nothing_to_scan: Michel found nothing to check in this folder.
api.project.nothing_to_scan_hint: It looks for the list of libraries (the code your project borrows): composer.lock, package-lock.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml. Check that you gave the right folder. If your project has none, there is nothing to compare.
api.project.relative_path: Michel needs the full path of the folder.
api.project.relative_path_hint: Write it from the start, without "..": for example C:\Sites\my-site on Windows, /home/you/my-site elsewhere.
api.project.scan_failed: The check of this project failed.
api.project.scan_failed_hint: Try again. If it happens again, the reason is written in the window where Michel runs.
api.project.scan_panic: The check of %s stopped on an internal error: %v
api.project.scan_running: A check of this project is already running.
api.project.scan_running_hint: No need to click again: the result will show here when it ends.
api.project.scan_unavailable: Michel cannot check a project from this page right now.
api.project.scan_unavailable_hint: Start Michel again, then try again.
api.project.patch.bad_json_hint: Send one JSON object with only the fields fix_level and auto_fix_minor.
api.project.patch.bad_level: A fix level must be a whole number from 0 to 3.
api.project.patch.nothing: There is nothing to change: send at least one of the fields fix_level or auto_fix_minor.
api.project_not_found: No active project has this name.
api.source.add.bad_input: Give the full path of the report on this computer.
api.source.add.exists: A source with the key %s already exists. Pick another name.
api.source.add.feed_target: A feed needs an https:// address, or a GitHub repository (owner/name) with the format github_advisories.
api.source.add.no_ecosystem: An OSV source (a database of known flaws) needs the name of the software family, for example PyPI.
api.source.add.no_format: A plugin needs the format of its report: sarif or trivy_json.
api.source.add.no_name: Give the source a name (letters or digits).
api.source.add.no_repo: A %s source needs a GitHub repository (owner/name) and the 40-character id of the version to install.
api.source.audit_failed: The change is made, but Michel could not write it to the audit log.
api.source.bad_json_hint: Send one JSON object with only the fields of this action.
api.source.bad_since: Michel cannot read the start date.
api.source.bad_since_hint: Use a number of days (7d), of hours (48h) or a date (YYYY-MM-DD).
api.source.consent_needed: This source contacts the internet: Michel needs your consent first.
api.source.consent_needed_hint: Read what Michel will contact and why, then turn it on again with your consent (consent: true).
api.source.failed: Michel could not do it for %s: %s
api.source.install.bad_sha: This is not the version the preview showed. Open the preview again.
api.source.install.not_enabled: %s is not on yet: turn it on first, with your consent.
api.source.install.old_folder_kept: Installed, but Michel could not remove the previous folder of this skill. Remove it yourself if you no longer need it.
api.source.remove.confirm: %s is installed on this computer: removing it uninstalls it.
api.source.remove.confirm_hint: Confirm to uninstall it and remove it (confirm: true).
api.source.reset.usage: Give a source key, or all.
api.source.reset.user: %s is a source you added: resetting only works for the sources of Michel's catalog.
api.source.run.not_plugin: %s is not a plugin: only a plugin can be run.
api.source.run.off: %s is off. Turn it on first.
api.source.update.busy: An update is already running. Wait for it to end.
api.source.upgrade.nothing: No new version of %s is known. Michel checks the repository at each update.
api.target.allow_failed: The server was not saved: Michel could not write its network rule in the policy file.
api.target.allow_failed_hint: Check that the policy file can be written, then try again.
api.target.bad_classification: The classification must be public, internal, confidential, sensitive or health.
api.target.bad_env: The role of the server must be prod, preprod or dev.
api.target.bad_executor: Who runs the fixes must be user or michel.
api.target.bad_fix_level: The fix level must be between 0 and 3.
api.target.bad_host: The server needs an address: a name (like example.org) or an IPv4 address (four numbers, like 192.0.2.10), without a wildcard, user name, access number or path.
api.target.bad_host_hint: Use the host name of the server: an IPv6 address cannot be written as a network rule.
api.target.bad_interval: The check interval must be manual, or a duration between 5 minutes and 365 days, for example 12h.
api.target.bad_kind: The kind of server must be vps, shared or hds.
api.target.bad_name: The name is empty, too long (64 characters at most) or holds an invisible character.
api.target.bad_name_hint: Choose a short name, for example the alias of the server.
api.target.bad_port: The access number (port) must be a number between 1 and 65535.
api.target.bad_remote_dir: A project folder on the server must be an absolute path below another folder: not the root, /home, /root or a home folder itself.
api.target.bad_site_url: The address of the site must start with http:// or https://.
api.target.bad_sudo: The sudo setting must be none or nopasswd.
api.target.bad_user: The user name to connect to the server is missing.
api.target.bad_user_hint: Give the user you sign in with on the server.
api.target.busy: Michel is working on this server right now.
api.target.busy_approved: A fix you run yourself is approved and waits for you.
api.target.busy_approved_hint: Run it and tell Michel, or refuse it, then try again.
api.target.busy_hint: Wait for the check or the fix to end, then try again.
api.target.busy_unknown: A fix on this server ended without Michel knowing what it changed.
api.target.busy_unknown_hint: Check the server yourself, then mark the fix as checked.
api.target.check_failed_hint: Try again. If it fails again, type michel target check in a terminal (the window where commands are typed): this command runs the check again and shows what it can.
api.target.check_running: A check of this server is already running.
api.target.denied: The network policy does not allow this server.
api.target.denied_hint: Michel adds this permission when you add a server. If it was removed, put the server's address back in his rules file: in network.allow, with the purpose target.ssh. Ask whoever manages your computer if this means nothing to you.
api.target.discover_failed: Michel could not read the connections saved on this computer (the SSH configuration file, which keeps the addresses of your servers).
api.target.discover_failed_hint: This file may be unreadable or badly written. Ask whoever manages your computer to check it, then try again, or add the server by hand.
api.target.duplicate: A server already has this name.
api.target.exposure_no_fix: Michel cannot close this service and starts nothing.
api.target.finding_not_found: This server has no finding with this id.
api.target.hds_health: A server that hosts health data is always classified health.
api.target.hostkey_changed: The server shows another fingerprint than the one you confirmed: Michel did not connect.
api.target.hostkey_changed_hint: It can be an attack: someone posing as your server. It can also be a reinstall. Confirm the new fingerprint only if you know why it changed.
api.target.hostkey_mismatch: This fingerprint is not the one the server shows: nothing was saved.
api.target.hostkey_mismatch_hint: Read the fingerprint again, and check that this is the right server.
api.target.hostkey_unknown: Michel does not know the fingerprint of this server yet: confirm it first.
api.target.inactive: Michel no longer checks this server: turn it back on first.
api.target.logs_failed: Michel could not erase what it read in the logs of this server, so the server is not removed.
api.target.logs_failed_hint: Try again. If it keeps failing, stop michel serve and start it again.
api.target.need_fingerprint: Michel needs the fingerprint you read.
api.target.need_fingerprint_hint: Read the fingerprint shown, compare it with the one your host gives, then send it.
api.target.no_agent: Michel cannot find your connection key: the program on your computer that holds it (the SSH agent) is not running or has none. Start it and add your key (command ssh-add).
api.target.no_agent_hint: Michel only connects with the keys this program holds. On Windows, check that the OpenSSH Authentication Agent service runs, or set ssh.agent_pipe in his rules file. Ask whoever manages your computer if this means nothing to you.
api.target.no_key_accepted: The server refused the connection keys held by the program on your computer (the SSH agent). Check the user name, and ask whoever manages the server to allow your key. Michel never uses passwords.
api.target.preprod_chain: A preprod server cannot have a preprod itself. A server that already is the preprod of another cannot have one either.
api.target.preprod_not_found: The preprod server is not a server of Michel: add it first.
api.target.preprod_role: A preprod server must have the role preprod or dev, and a production server cannot be the preprod of another.
api.target.preprod_self: A server cannot be its own preprod.
api.target.state.checking: Michel is checking this server now.
api.target.state.clean: The last check found no flaw waiting.

cli.fix.not_found: No fix attempt has the id %q. Run 'michel fix status' to see the ids.

cli.fix.project_not_found: Cannot show the consent of %s: no project has this name. Run 'michel project list' to see the registered names.
cli.fix.refuse.done: Fix %s refused: nothing was applied, the finding waits for your decision.

cli.fix.status.head: Fix %s: %s

cli.fix.withdraw.done: Fix %s ended: the agent did not start and, for this fix, nothing left your computer.

fix.msg.tests_dropped: The AI made a new proposal while the tests ran: this result is only about the old one, so Michel did not keep it. Read the new proposal.
fix.msg.tests_error: Michel could not finish running the tests (%s). It recorded nothing: the tests still wait for your go-ahead.
fix.msg.tests_interrupted: The tests took too long or were stopped: Michel recorded nothing. They still wait for your go-ahead.
fix.msg.tests_none: Tests: not run, no test command is configured for this project.
fix.msg.update_refused: Michel did not run the update: %s. The fix starts from the project's current files.
fix.msg.weak_hits.one: Michel saw %d line that talks about a password or a key (%s), with nothing that looks like a real key. It does not stop the agent: it can read it, and what it reads reaches Anthropic. If it does hold a real key, take it out of this file, put it in a .env file (Michel never copies that file) and save the change in Git (a commit).
fix.msg.weak_hits.other: Michel saw %d lines that talk about a password or a key (%s), with nothing that looks like a real key. They do not stop the agent: it can read them, and what it reads reaches Anthropic. fix.server.agent_refused.ambiguous: Several files set this setting: the action must name one of them.
fix.server.agent_refused.directive: The setting is not one of Michel's rules.
fix.server.agent_refused.downgrade: The version is not newer than the installed one.
fix.server.agent_refused.link: The file is a link: Michel does not change a file through a link.
fix.server.agent_refused.major: This upgrade moves to another PHP version (for example from 8.2 to 8.3) or to a major version: Michel can only explain it, never prepare it as a script.
fix.server.agent_refused.malformed: The proposal is not valid: an unknown action, a missing field, or no change at all.
fix.server.agent_refused.package: This software (package) is not installed on the server, or its version is not valid.
fix.server.agent_refused.path: The file is not one Michel may change (only the php.ini PHP loads, its other ini files, a PHP-FPM pool or a .user.ini seen on the server).
fix.server.agent_refused.service: The service is not a PHP-FPM service seen on the server.
fix.server.agent_refused.simulation: The trial run of the package manager (a try that changes nothing) refuses this update: it would remove or replace something, or it fails.
fix.server.agent_refused.simulation_limi: This attempt has already used all its trial runs of the package manager (tries that change nothing): the update can no longer be prepared as a script, only explained.
fix.server.agent_refused.unreachable: Michel could not reach the server to try the upgrade: nothing was tried.
fix.server.agent_refused.untestable: The PHP of this server is not the system's: Michel cannot test the configuration.
fix.server.agent_refused.value: The value is refused: it holds characters a setting must not hold, or it would weaken the server.
fix.server.already_applied: This fix was already run once on the server: Michel never runs the same one twice. Prepare a new fix.
fix.server.ambiguous: Several files set this setting on the server: Michel does not know which one to change.
fix.server.busy: A fix is already waiting or running on this server. Wait for it to end, or find it in To do: finish it or refuse it first.
fix.server.busy_preprod: A fix is already waiting or running on your preprod %s, and this fix must go through the preprod first. Wait for it to end, or find it in To do: finish it or refuse it first.
fix.server.check_failed: The fix ran, but checking the server again did not work: Michel cannot prove it.
fix.server.check_partial: The fix ran, but the check could not look at everything: Michel cannot prove it.
fix.server.cannot_judge_db: The fix ran, but Michel cannot tell whether the problem is solved: the public list of flaws called %s is not downloaded yet. Update it in the Sources page, then check the server again.
fix.server.cannot_judge_source: The fix ran, but Michel cannot tell whether the problem is solved: to judge it, he needs the public list of flaws called %s, which is turned off for now. Turn it on in the Sources page, then check the server again.
fix.server.explain.append: Add the line %s = %s at the end of %s.
fix.server.explain.backup: Save a copy of %s on the server (in %s). Michel never deletes it.
fix.server.explain.check_site: Then Michel checks from your computer that the site still answers.
fix.server.explain.executor_michel: Once you validate, Michel runs the script over his secure connection and follows each step. If the site has an address and stops answering, he undoes it at once, except a software update: only your snapshot (a full copy of the server) takes you back then.
fix.server.explain.executor_user: Michel does not run this script: copy it and run it on the server yourself, then click "I applied it". Keep the undo script at hand.
fix.server.explain.mitigation: This setting only holds the flaw back: the PHP update is still needed.
fix.server.explain.no_link: A file that is a symbolic link (a shortcut to another file) is never read nor changed.
fix.server.explain.package: Update the software %s to version %s, without removing any other software.
fix.server.explain.recollect: Then Michel checks the server again to prove the problem is gone.
fix.server.explain.reload: Reload %s (no restart: the site keeps answering).
fix.server.explain.root: The script must be run with the server's administrator rights (called "root"): otherwise it stops at once.
fix.server.explain.test_cli: Have PHP read %s. If PHP complains, the saved files are put back.
fix.server.explain.test_fpm: Test the PHP-FPM configuration (the part of PHP that serves your site). If the test fails, the saved files are put back.
fix.server.explain.trap: If a step fails after a change, the script puts the saved files back and reloads.
fix.server.explain.undo: To go back: the undo script puts the saved files back, tests and reloads.
fix.server.explain.undo_snapshot: A software update has no undo script: your snapshot (a full copy of the server) is the way back. Make one before you validate.
fix.server.explain.user: The script runs as the account %s, the one Michel connects with, never with administrator rights (root).
fix.server.finding_gone: The last check of the server no longer sees this problem: there is nothing to fix.
fix.server.line_moved: The file changed on the server since the last check: the script changed nothing. Michel checks the server again and prepares a new fix.
fix.server.link: A file to change is a symbolic link (a shortcut to another file): the script changed nothing. Fix this file by hand.
fix.server.major_upgrade: This upgrade changes a major version: Michel only explains it, it never runs it.
fix.server.needs_agent: Michel has no ready-made fix for this problem: it needs to be looked at case by case.
fix.server.no_inventory: Michel has never checked this server: check it first, then prepare the fix.
fix.server.not_michel: Michel does not run this fix on the server: copy the script and run it yourself, then tell Michel you applied it.
fix.server.off: This server is turned off in Michel: nothing runs on it. Turn it back on in its settings if you want Michel to run this script.
fix.server.not_run: The script could not be started on the server: nothing changed.
fix.server.not_server: This finding is not about a server.
fix.server.not_user: Michel runs this fix itself: there is nothing for you to run.
fix.server.package_failed: The software update failed and the software may have changed. No script can undo it: restore the snapshot you made, then check the server.
fix.server.preprod_missing: The preprod server linked to this one does not show this problem, so the fix cannot be tried there first. Check the preprod again, or unlink it to fix the production directly.
fix.server.refused: Michel refused this fix: it would touch a file, a value or a piece of software he does not allow.
fix.server.report_only: This server is set to report only: Michel prepares no fix for it. Change its fix level to prepare one.
fix.server.rollback_failed: The fix failed and the server could not be put back as before. Look at the server now: the saved copies of the files are listed on the page.
fix.server.rolled_back: The fix did not work and was undone: the server is as before.
fix.server.script_changed: The scripts are no longer exactly the ones you validated (the server or the stored fix changed): Michel sent nothing. Prepare the fix again.
fix.server.scripts_unreadable: The scripts of this fix cannot be shown as they are: Michel does not validate them. Prepare the fix again.
fix.server.simulation_refused: The trial run (a try that changes nothing) refuses this update: it would remove or replace a piece of software, or the try failed. Michel applied nothing.
fix.server.site_down_after_upgrade: The site no longer answers since the software update. No script can undo it: restore the snapshot you made now.
fix.server.site_down_user: The site no longer answers since the fix: run the undo script on the server now.
fix.server.site_unchecked: The fix ran and the check no longer sees the problem, but Michel could not check the site. Open it yourself to make sure it answers.
fix.server.snapshot_required: This fix updates a piece of software and no script can undo it: first make a snapshot (a full copy of the server) at your host, then tick "Snapshot done".
fix.server.still_seen: The fix ran, but the check still sees the problem.
fix.server.stopped: The script stopped before changing anything.
fix.server.sudo_refused: sudo (the command that gives administrator rights) asked for a password on the server: the script was not run and nothing changed. Ask whoever manages the server to set sudo so it asks Michel's account for none, or run the script yourself.
fix.server.unknown_state: The script gave no answer (time limit reached or connection lost): Michel cannot tell what it changed. Check the server now.
fix.server.unsafe: A folder or file of the fix can be changed by someone other than the server's administrator (root): the script stopped before changing anything.
fix.server.untestable_binary: The PHP of this server is not a system one: Michel cannot test its configuration, so it prepares no script.
fix.server.user_checked: You checked the server yourself, so Michel closed this fix.
fix.server.wrong_user: The script stopped before changing anything: it was not run by the right user (the server's administrator, "root", for PHP's settings; the site's user for a .user.ini).

serverrules.allow_url_include.explain: With allow_url_include on, a bug in a site can make PHP load and run code from another server. Setting it to 0 forbids it; no normal site needs it.
serverrules.allow_url_include.title: PHP may run code fetched from a web address
serverrules.display_errors_prod.explain: With display_errors on, a PHP error prints file paths and sometimes secrets on the page, which helps an attacker. Setting it to 0 hides them from visitors; errors still go to the log.
serverrules.display_errors_prod.title: Errors are shown to visitors on a production server
serverrules.eol.explain: The PHP team no longer publishes security fixes for this branch, so new flaws stay open. Move to a branch that is still supported.
serverrules.eol.title: This PHP branch no longer gets fixes
serverrules.expose_php.explain: With expose_php (a PHP setting) on, every answer of the server tells which PHP version runs, which helps an attacker pick a known flaw. Setting it to 0 stops this.
serverrules.expose_php.title: PHP announces its version
serverrules.exposed_cache.explain: Michel infers this from the access number he sees on the server, without connecting to the service. It can be reached from outside if no firewall (the filter that decides who may connect) blocks it. Usually nobody outside needs to reach it: if so here, it is a possible way in to your data.
serverrules.exposed_cache.title: A cache (a fast memory sites often use) seems open to all on this server
serverrules.exposed_database.explain: Michel infers this from the access number he sees on the server, without connecting to the service. It can be reached from outside if no firewall (the filter that decides who may connect) blocks it. Usually nobody outside needs to reach it: if so here, it is a possible way in to your data.
serverrules.exposed_database.title: A database seems open to all on this server
serverrules.fatal_error_backtraces_off.e: On PHP 8.5, this setting can help the PHP2Shell flaw be reached. Setting fatal_error_backtraces to 0 blocks that path but does not fix PHP: you still need to update it.
serverrules.fatal_error_backtraces_off.t: Fatal errors print a full backtrace
serverrules.open_basedir_shared.explain: Without open_basedir, a PHP script on shared hosting can read files outside its own site, such as the sites of other customers. Set it to your site folder so PHP stays inside it.
serverrules.open_basedir_shared.title: PHP can read the files of other sites
serverrules.php2shell.explain: A critical flaw in this PHP version lets an attacker run commands on the server. Update PHP to the fixed version, or a later one, of the same branch.
serverrules.php2shell.title: PHP2Shell: PHP can be taken over remotely
serverrules.session_cookie_secure.explai: Without session.cookie_secure, the cookie that keeps visitors logged in may be sent over a plain http connection, where it can be stolen. Setting it to 1 sends it only over https.
serverrules.session_cookie_secure.title: The session cookie can travel without encryption
This feature is one way the PHP2Shell flaw can be reached. Setting session.upload_progress.enabled to 0 blocks that path but does not fix PHP: you still need to update it.
serverrules.version_unknown.explain: Michel could not read the version of this PHP, so it cannot tell whether it has the PHP2Shell flaw. Check the version by hand and update PHP if it is older than the fixed one.
serverrules.version_unknown.title: The PHP version could not be read
source.consent.discover: Michel will ask %s which public projects are the most followed on a few topics. Only the names of these topics leave, plus your GitHub token if you gave one (GitHub then knows it is you).
source.consent.enrichment: Michel will contact %s to download a public list about vulnerabilities. Nothing from your projects leaves: it is a download.
source.consent.enrichment_on_demand: Michel will send the CVE numbers of your findings (the official code of each vulnerability) to %s. Nothing else leaves.
source.consent.feed: Michel will contact %s to read a security feed. Nothing from your projects leaves: it is a download.
source.consent.osv: Michel will contact %s to download a public vulnerability database. Nothing from your projects leaves: it is a download.
source.consent.repo: Michel will contact %s to read a public project: what it contains and the chosen version. If you gave a GitHub token, GitHub will know it is you.
source.note.discover.github: Lists the most followed GitHub projects on the mcp-security and claude-skills topics. You choose the ones you add.
source.note.enrich.circl: European database of flaws, another source than the NVD (the official US database). Michel sends it the official numbers of your flaws (CVE numbers).
source.note.enrich.epss: Estimates the chance that attackers use a vulnerability within 30 days. Michel downloads the file of the day: nothing is sent.
source.note.enrich.kev: Official list of the vulnerabilities attackers already use. Michel downloads the whole list: nothing about you is sent.
source.note.enrich.nvd: Fills in the missing severity scores of flaws (CVSS). This service is slow and limits the number of requests. A key (michel secret set nvd-api-key) raises that limit. Michel sends it the official numbers of flaws (CVE numbers).
source.note.enrich.vulnrichment: Adds a severity score (CVSS) and other ratings (SSVC, CWE) to the flaws that have none. Michel sends it the official numbers of your flaws (CVE numbers).
